chapters.label: The free kick, live
chapters.text: Saint-Étienne, 1984. France against Yugoslavia, and Michel Platini has scored twice. Free kick to France. Platini steps up... over the wall, top corner! Hat-trick!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. His right foot strikes the ball's side. It loops over the wall and dips into the top corner. Left foot, head, right foot: a perfect hat-trick!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Hit the middle and the ball flies straight. Hit its side and it spins and curls. Your turn: curl it over the wall by striking the side of the ball.
